# CommandPalette

Quick search across tracks, artists, sets, pages and actions, opened with Ctrl/⌘ K or / from anywhere, showing key, BPM and energy in track rows.

`SongNodes.CommandPalette` · Navigation

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.CommandPalette open onClose={…} search={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.CommandPalette" open="{{yes}}" on-close="{{…}}" search="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (CommandPaletteProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `open` * | `boolean` | Open state (Ctrl/⌘ K and / open it). |
| `onClose` * | `() => void` | Called on the second Esc or a scrim click. |
| `search` * | `(query: string) => PaletteGroup[]` | Search function; a Camelot code filters by key, a 2–3 digit number by BPM ±1. |
| `recent` * | `PaletteGroup[]` | Groups shown before typing (recent items, a few pages and actions). |
| `onPick` * | `(item: PaletteItem) => void` | Called with the chosen result. |

### PaletteGroup

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` * | `"Tracks" \| "Artists" \| "Sets" \| "Pages" \| "Actions" \| string` |  |
| `items` * | `PaletteItem[]` |  |

### PaletteItem

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` * | `string` | Stable id. |
| `kind` * | `"track" \| "artist" \| "set" \| "page" \| "action"` | Kind of result; decides the row layout. |
| `name` * | `string` | Main text (track title, artist, set or page name, action verb). |
| `sub` | `string` | Secondary text (artist for a track, "38 tracks", "18 tracks · 1 h 32 min"). |
| `track` | `{ key?: string; bpm?: number; energy?: number }` | Track data shown at the right. |
| `module` | `"graph" \| "library" \| "sets" \| "paths" \| "harmony" \| "sources" \| "pipeline" \| "services"` | Destination module for icon colour. |
| `icon` * | `string` | Lucide icon name. |
| `shortcut` | `string` | Shortcut hint for actions. |
